title: Price Disclosure → Collector Intent
objective: Measure whether showing a proposed collector price before acquisition details changes explicit collector intent.

common_after_details_click.primary_confirmation: I would consider collecting at 0.01 ETH
common_after_details_click.disclosure: Research interest check only. No purchase, wallet connection, payment, listing, or transaction occurs.

hypothesis: Showing the proposed price before the acquisition-details click will increase the rate of explicit collector-intent confirmations per page-view session.

stopping_rule.threshold: 20 distinct page_view sessions in EACH variant
stopping_rule.rule: Stop at the first of threshold reached or maximum duration reached.

semantics.collector_intent_confirm_means: Anonymous stated willingness to consider collecting at the proposed price.

launch_gate: Deploy a dedicated EXP-008 collector and D1 database.
Replace collector endpoint placeholder in the public page.
Replace allowed-origin placeholder in the Worker.
Publish from a dedicated public repository or dedicated public path.
Run clean end-to-end telemetry validation and delete test rows.
Human approval is required before any Moltbook post or financial/on-chain action.
